long.state: Hello support team, I have been a customer for several years and I am writing because the latest update of your mobile application has caused a number of problems on my account. After installing version 4.2 the app logs me out every few minutes, the settings page crashes as soon as I open it, and yesterday I noticed that my monthly subscription was billed twice on my credit card statement. I tried reinstalling the application, clearing the cache and resetting my password, but nothing helped.
